name: Jersey triplet vocal chops
desc: Jersey club vocal science: pitched-up yeah/miniyeah cuts stuttered into the signature hey-hey-hey triplet rolls, bright and high-passed, riding the 5-kick grid. Euphoric peak doubles the rolls and throws a fast(2) turnaround — pure Newark club joy.

code.full: s("<[yeah:6 ~ yeah:6 ~] [~ [yeah:6 yeah:6 yeah:6] ~ ~] [yeah:12 ~ yeah:12 ~] [~ ~ [miniyeah miniyeah miniyeah] ~]>").speed(${spd}).hpf(400).shape(.3).gain(${gain}).room(.22).delay(.2).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.35).orbit(8).play()
code.peak: s("<[yeah:6 ~ [yeah:6 yeah:6 yeah:6] ~] [[yeah:6 yeah:6 yeah:6] ~ yeah:6 ~] [yeah:12 ~ [yeah:12 yeah:12 yeah:12] ~] [[miniyeah miniyeah miniyeah] ~ miniyeah ~]>").speed(${spd}).hpf(450).shape(.35).gain(${gain}).room(.2).delay(.2).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.35).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(8).play()
